recommendation_en: Fast and slow advancement of feeding In preterm or low-birth-weight (LBW) infants, including very preterm (< 32 weeks’ gestation) or very LBW (< 1.5 kg) infants, who need to be fed by an alternative feeding method to breastfeeding (e.g. gastric tube feeding or cup feeding), feed volumes can be increased by up to 30 ml/kg per day. (Conditional recommendation, moderate-certainty evidence)
recommendation_zh: 早产或低出生体重（LBW）婴儿，包括极早产（< 32周妊娠）或极低体重（< 1.5 kg）婴儿，如需采用非母乳喂养的替代喂养方法（例如胃管喂养或杯喂养），可每日增加喂养量至30 ml/kg。 （条件推荐，中等确定性证据）
